grain: sk_customerid (primary key); one row per customer version record

branches.from:
FROM CustomerXML AS c
LEFT JOIN NameXML AS n ON c.Customer_Id = n.Customer_Id
LEFT JOIN AddressXML AS a ON c.Customer_Id = a.Customer_Id
LEFT JOIN ContactInfoXML AS ci ON c.Customer_Id = ci.Customer_Id
LEFT JOIN C_PHONE_1_XML AS p1 ON ci.ContactInfo_Id = p1.ContactInfo_Id
LEFT JOIN C_PHONE_2_XML AS p2 ON ci.ContactInfo_Id = p2.ContactInfo_Id
LEFT JOIN C_PHONE_3_XML AS p3 ON ci.ContactInfo_Id = p3.ContactInfo_Id
LEFT JOIN TaxInfoXML AS t ON c.Customer_Id = t.Customer_Id
LEFT JOIN TaxRate AS tr_nat ON t.C_NAT_TX_ID = tr_nat.TX_ID
LEFT JOIN TaxRate AS tr_loc ON t.C_LCL_TX_ID = tr_loc.TX_ID
LEFT JOIN ActionXML AS act ON c.Action_Id = act.Action_Id

joins: LEFT JOIN TaxRate (national) on C_NAT_TX_ID = TX_ID
LEFT JOIN TaxRate (local) on C_LCL_TX_ID = TX_ID

assumptions: All joins use the supplied inferred links; no additional join conditions are assumed.
The one-to-one links between CustomerXML and NameXML, AddressXML, ContactInfoXML, TaxInfoXML, and ActionXML are trusted despite differing distinct counts; missing matches produce NULLs via LEFT JOIN.
Phone tables are joined through ContactInfoXML.ContactInfo_Id; each phone table is left-joined separately so a customer may have up to three phone numbers.
TaxRate is joined twice, once for national tax (C_NAT_TX_ID) and once for local tax (C_LCL_TX_ID).
Prospect is not used because there is no link to CustomerXML; agencyid, creditrating, networth, and marketingnameplate will be NULL unless populated by later formulas from another source.
sk_customerid is a generated surrogate key assigned after stacking and de-duplication; order_by uses customerid and effectivedate for stable numbering.
